title: Standalone video batch manifest
description: A record in stories/standalone/<batch>.json: one batch of standalone videos built outside the seven-act programme. Each video records its source formats, source-time excisions, overlays, optional full-frame takeover, thumbnail pick and audio probes -- provenance and timecodes, never the footage. The schema is closed (additionalProperties: false at every level) so a hand-edited field fails loudly instead of being silently ignored by tools/standalone.py.

cta_asset.description: Path to the approved full-frame CTA picture shared by every takeover in the batch.

cuts.description: Authored excisions in source time. tools/standalone.py maps every source-time mark through these before rendering.

video_format_id.description: The yt-dlp video format pinned for reproducibility.

audio_format_id.description: The yt-dlp audio format pinned for reproducibility. A '-drc' format is forbidden: DRC (dynamic range compression) normalises the loudness the audio-quality tenet says to preserve. Rejected here at schema level so the committed-record gate (tests/test_index_integrity.py) catches it without the loader, and again by tools/standalone.py for uncommitted manifests.

usage_class.description: Rights bucket. The enum is generated from vocab/provenance.yaml by scripts/generate_schema_enums.py; never hand-edit it.

source_at.description: Source time at which the CTA picture replaces the video through EOF, preserving source audio unchanged.

asset.description: Optional per-video CTA picture, committed under assets/cta/, overriding the batch-level cta_asset for this video only. Owner-approved per-video copy is a separate committed asset; the shared card is never mutated.

source_at.description: Source time the thumbnail frame is extracted from.

why.description: The frame evidence behind this mark -- what the picture shows under the title lockup and why the subject stays readable. Optional, but a reseated mark without it invites the same wrong pick back.

kind.description: An existing plate kind rendered by tools/plate.py; nothing new is invented for this batch.

source_at.description: Source time the plate appears; mapped through the video's cuts before rendering.

copy_source.description: Where the on-screen words came from -- the record that they are reproduced, never invented.

trustee.description: Use the established burnished-silver trustee chrome for an authored Guardian identity.

intro.description: A DIFFERENT picture spliced ahead of this video's own source, joined by a hard cut. The batch's one exception to 'a video has one source'. Declared by path and digest rather than committed, because it is a render output and renders/ is gitignored -- the same posture scripts/build_europa_tail.py takes for its source screenshot. Plates are composited onto the source before the join, so an intro never moves an authored seat.

path.description: Path to the intro picture on disk. Never committed.

sha256.description: The intro file's digest. A mismatch DROPS the intro and ships the cut without it, rather than splicing a picture the record does not describe.
